founder.subtitle: MEET OUR PRINCIPAL
founder.name: Ir. Ar. IGN Andri Saputra, IAI.
founder.bio_p1: I Gusti Ngurah Andri Saputra, a Balinese-born architect, founded Nyoman Undagi in 2010. Following his graduation from Udayana University, rather than immediately establishing his own practice, he spent formative years gaining hands-on mastery working alongside prominent Australian and French architectural firms in Bali to cultivate rigorous discipline and fine craft.
founder.bio_p2: His driving motivation is deeply personal. Growing up in Bali immersed within community and family traditions, he observed how homes nurture and shape lives. Those vivid childhood memories inspired his lifelong purpose: to design living spaces where families reconnect, friendships flourish, and life feels inherently balanced.
founder.bio_p3: Today, Nyoman Undagi comprises a dedicated team of 67 professionals. Celebrated across 450+ projects in Bali and prestigious international destinations including Singapore, Thailand, the Bahamas, Nigeria, and India, our work embodies timeless architecture infused with international sensibility and elevated living.
founder.quote_sub: This philosophy inspires us to deliver a deeply meaningful design journey for our clients, far beyond blueprints and drawings.
